summary: security checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; not clear and not evidence of compromise. Fleet-doctor has no run or findings, and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Security site facts are unknown for all 61 managed sites. Authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. No TLS certificates are recorded as expiring within 30 days, but TLS configuration and certificate validation remain unverified. Exact decision: block new public exposure, security-sensitive releases, and gated-product launch changes pending evidence. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves compliance boundaries.

Evidence severity: high for release and launch decisions because material preventive and detective controls cannot be verified; unknown does not mean compromised. Compliance evidence independently shows 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown sites with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Continue read-only evidence capture only; do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
